title: Clean limit buy, ample cash, market open
instruction: buy 10 shares of GOOGL with a limit price of $175.00
notes: $80,000 equity/cash/buying_power account, no positions, no open orders. 10 sh @ 175.00 limit = 1750.00 notional exposure, 1750/80000 = 2.19% of equity (cap 15%). Buying power (80000.00) comfortably covers 1750.00. Market is open, GOOGL is tradable. Nothing fires; ALLOW with the order unchanged.
